verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly offer an API, bulk data feed, or other scriptable filing path, so the headless/CI axis applies. The evidence only describes interactive browser filings: online forms, credit-card payment, typed signatures, and a web application tested against supported browsers. Nothing in the pack documents a headless, CLI, API, or CI-friendly way to run Sunbiz tasks; browser compatibility and the e-filing host's robots.txt response are adjacent details that earn no credit.
